question: What is the implied trajectory of Apple's effective tax rate and what factors are driving it?

question: Compare the risk factor disclosures related to the App Store in the FY2023 10-K vs the Q2 FY2024 10-Q. What new risks emerged?
ground_truth: FY2023 10-K: General discussion of DMA requiring compliance by March 2024, mentions potential changes to developer communications/distribution/fees, notes Epic litigation with ongoing appeals. Q2 FY2024 10-Q Updates (NEW developments): (1) DMA Investigations - March 25, 2024 Commission opened TWO formal noncompliance investigations on Article 5(4) (developer communication) and Article 6(3) (default settings, browser choice), potential penalty up to 10% of worldwide annual net sales; (2) DOJ Lawsuit - March 21, 2024 DOJ + 16 state AGs filed antitrust lawsuit alleging monopolization in 'performance smartphones' and 'smartphones' markets seeking equitable relief; (3) Epic Compliance Dispute - January 2024 Apple implemented compliance plan, March 2024 Epic filed motion disputing compliance. Risk escalation: Material escalation from theoretical regulatory risk (10-K) to active investigations and litigation with quantified penalty exposure.
